blocks.html: Robinsons Magnolia's atrium is transformed into an enchanted Winter Wonderland! Be dazzled by the giant 40-feet snow-capped white Christmas Tree adorned with thousands of intricate ornaments: giant bright lit symbols of winter like ice skates and snowflakes, shiny and glittered trimmings and a celebration of polar bears. Gather around the snow-capped forest and be serenaded by life-size snowmen singing and dancing to your favorite Christmas jingles. Keep smiling as you listen and enjoy the sights and sounds of the joys that come with the Christmas season.

Feel even more of the magic walking through the mesmerizing garden at Robinsons Magnolia. Be fascinated by the colorful illuminations of the Christmas village filled with charming snowmen brightening the holiday season. Pose for that perfect holiday photo while enjoying your shopping to complete your gift giving shopping list at your favorite stores around the mall and dine at some of the finest restaurants in Quezon City at Robinsons Magnolia.
Visit us and feel the joy of Christmas! Together, let's create a memorable holiday celebration at Robinsons Malls!
